 - name: Swarms
 descri
ption: >-\n Personas, journeys and swarm containers — the authoring half of Swarms —\n plus the model-backed generation

that drafts them.
 - name: Swarm runs
 description: >-
 Launching journeys and reading what they produced. Launching S

PENDS — see
 the per-operation notes.
 - name: Swarm insights
 description: >-
 What a swarm run revealed. The s
corecard and findings are deterministic\n and free; requesting wave insights runs models and draws on your shared\n dail

y ledger.
 - name: Directory readiness
 description: >-
 Grade a saved server against a publisher's listing requiremen
ts:\n Anthropic's connector directory or OpenAI's plugin directory. Reported as\n lane status and coverage, never as a n
umeric score, and excluded from\n `pooledConformanceScore`. Deterministic grading is free; model-backed\n experience obs
ervations are an explicit opt-in whose model cost is on\n MCPJam — no credits are consumed — and they can never decide a verd

ict.
 - name: Registry
 description: >-
 Search the scraped MCP directories (Claude, ChatGPT, and any future
 so
urce), list curated/org registry cards, and install them into a project.\n Install writes a `servers` row and provenance — it
does not open a live\n session. There is no catalog-uninstall route: delete the project server\n instead. Directory rea
ds require a bearer (including minted guest tokens)\n but do not materialize a user. Card/connection reads and all writes are

authed-non-guest.
 - name: Feedback
 description: >-
 Feedback about MCPJam itself (bugs, missing capabilities
, confusing\n behavior), sent to the MCPJam team and kept for 180 days. The\n `send_feedback` MCP tool calls the same en

dpoint.

 get:
 tags:
 - Catalog
 summary: Read the organization's spend budget
 description: >-
The ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed work —\n chat, evals, judges and computer time — in t

he current billing window,
 and how much of it has been spent.


 Any member may read it: a member who cannot ra
ise the ceiling still\n needs to know it exists, because it is what refused their run. `capUsd:\n null` means the or

ganization is uncapped, which is the default.


 Runs that use your own provider keys are never counted against the
budget and never blocked by it. Neither is the free daily allowance — it\n is not credits.\n operationId: getSpen

dBudget
 responses:
 '200':
 description: The organization's spend budget.
 content:

application/json:

 $ref: '#/components/schemas/SpendBudget'

':
